findings.title: Slower earlier stats response overwrites the newer one, so the table no longer matches the chosen dates
findings.expected: After changing From to 2026-08-01 and then back to 2026-01-01, the page shows the stats for 1 Jan 2026 to 31 Dec 2026 (5 harvests)
findings.actual: The delayed earlier response arrives last and wins: the fields say 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31 but the page shows '2 harvests from 1 Aug 2026 to 31 Dec 2026' and Tomato as the only best plant
findings.evidence: {"fields":[{"label":"From","value":"2026-01-01"},{"label":"To","value":"2026-12-31"}],"text":["From","To","2 harvests from 1 Aug 2026 to 31 Dec 2026","Best plants","NO. 1","Tomato","600 g · Sungold","View","Tomato"]} | {"fields":[{"label":"From","value":"2026-01-01"},{"label":"To","value":"2026-12-31"}],"text":["From","To","2 harvests from 1 Aug 2026 to 31 Dec 2026","Best plants","NO. 1","Tomato","600 g · Sungold","View","Tomato"]}

findings.title: When loading fails, the summary line still shows the previous range's harvest count next to the error
findings.expected: When the stats request fails for a new range, the page shows only an error and no harvest count from an earlier range
findings.actual: '5 harvests from 1 Jan 2026 to 31 Dec 2026' stays visible above the 'Injected 500' error, even though From is now 2026-07-01
findings.evidence: ["From","To","This year","5 harvests from 1 Jan 2026 to 31 Dec 2026","Injected 500","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"] | ["From","To","This year","5 harvests from 1 Jan 2026 to 31 Dec 2026","Injected 500","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"]

findings.title: A stats request that never answers leaves 'Loading stats…' on screen forever, above the old range's table
findings.expected: A request that never answers ends in a visible error or a way to retry
findings.actual: After 13 s the page still shows 'Loading stats…', with the full-year table from before (2.6 kg total) under it, while From says 2026-07-01
findings.evidence: {"text":["From","To","This year","Loading stats…","Best plants","NO. 1","Courgette","1.2 kg","View","Courgette","NO. 2","Tomato"],"alerts":["Loading stats…"]} | {"text":["From","To","This year","Loading stats…","Best plants","NO. 1","Courgette","1.2 kg","View","Courgette","NO. 2","Tomato"],"alerts":["Loading stats…"]}

findings.title: A blank From field quietly becomes 1 Jan of this year, so a valid To date in an earlier year is refused
findings.expected: With From blank and To set to 2025-12-31, the page shows harvests up to that date, or asks for a From date
findings.actual: The server fills in From as 2026-01-01 and refuses with 'The From date must be on or before the To date.', even though the From field is empty; the old '5 harvests from 1 Jan 2026 to 31 Dec 2026' line also stays visible
